sources.title: AMReX Introduction
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: HPL：稠密基準的記憶體與問題規模
related.titleEn: HPL: dense-benchmark memory and problem size
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付AMR有效遮罩、格點預算與守恆測試；1700/2400正確，常數場體積總量守恆，儲存與有效量分欄；請另一位學徒依交付件重新推導一組；未通過或資料不足必須明記，不以品牌或峰值取代證據。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver active masks, cell budgets, and conservation tests. Verify 1700 and 2400 with constant-field conservation. Report storage separately from active cells. Have another learner derive one case from the handover; label failures or missing evidence without substituting brand names or peak rates.
related.difference: 畫主矩陣、右手邊及工作區三類，單獨記分散區塊，不把主矩陣值當峰值記憶體；兩容量正確、來源與合成輸入分開，速度結論僅來自有效完成的跑次。
related.differenceEn: Separate main matrix, right-hand side, and workspace. Include distributed blocks; main-matrix storage is not peak memory. Both capacities must match. Separate sourced context from teaching inputs and base speed claims only on valid completed runs.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 三維粗格N中比例f以每軸r倍細化，有效格數N(1−f)+Nfr³；覆蓋粗格不重複當有效；合成N=1000、f=.1、r2；改f=.2，無ghost cells；名義式 1000*(1-.1)+1000*.1*2**3 = 1700 active cells；變更式 1000*(1-.2)+1000*.2*2**3 = 2400 active cells。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。

FP64 n×n主矩陣容量8n² bytes，未含右手邊、pivot、工作區及分散儲存padding；合成n10000對20000，單位GiB以2^30換算；名義式 8*10000**2/2**30 = 0.745058059692 GiB main matrix；變更式 8*20000**2/2**30 = 2.98023223877 GiB main matrix。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: For refined fraction f and per-axis ratio r, active 3 D cells equal N(1−f) + N f r³. Covered coarse cells are excluded from active counts. Synthetic N = 1000, f = 0.1, r = 2; compare f = 0.2, excluding ghost cells. Nominal 1000*(1-.1)+1000*.1*2**3 = 1700 active cells; changed 1000*(1-.2)+1000*.2*2**3 = 2400 active cells. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.

A main FP64 n×n matrix requires 8 n² bytes, excluding the right-hand side, pivots, workspace, and distribution padding. Synthetic n = 10000 versus 20000. Convert bytes to GiB by dividing by 2^30. Nominal 8*10000**2/2**30 = 0.745058059692 GiB main matrix; changed 8*20000**2/2**30 = 2.98023223877 GiB main matrix. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: LLVM Vectorizer：資料相依與合法轉換
related.titleEn: LLVM vectorizer: dependencies and legal transformations
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付AMR有效遮罩、格點預算與守恆測試；1700/2400正確，常數場體積總量守恆，儲存與有效量分欄；請另一位學徒依交付件重新推導一組；未通過或資料不足必須明記，不以品牌或峰值取代證據。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver active masks, cell budgets, and conservation tests. Verify 1700 and 2400 with constant-field conservation. Report storage separately from active cells. Have another learner derive one case from the handover; label failures or missing evidence without substituting brand names or peak rates.
related.difference: 畫a0→a1→…→a8依賴鏈，另畫獨立b輸入；不可用pragma宣告消除真相依；10/13正確，轉換後逐元素吻合且每項編譯假設有證據。
related.differenceEn: Draw the chain a [0] through a [8] and separate independent inputs. A pragma cannot remove a real dependency. Verify final values 10 and 13 and every intermediate element. Supply evidence for all compiler assumptions.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 三維粗格N中比例f以每軸r倍細化，有效格數N(1−f)+Nfr³；覆蓋粗格不重複當有效；合成N=1000、f=.1、r2；改f=.2，無ghost cells；名義式 1000*(1-.1)+1000*.1*2**3 = 1700 active cells；變更式 1000*(1-.2)+1000*.2*2**3 = 2400 active cells。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
遞迴a[i]=a[i−1]+1有跨迭代相依，與a[i]=b[i]+1的獨立元素不同；合成a0=2，遞迴做到i8；另起a0=5，仍8次遞迴；名義式 2+8 = 10 a[8]；變更式 5+8 = 13 a[8]。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: For refined fraction f and per-axis ratio r, active 3 D cells equal N(1−f) + N f r³. Covered coarse cells are excluded from active counts. Synthetic N = 1000, f = 0.1, r = 2; compare f = 0.2, excluding ghost cells. Nominal 1000*(1-.1)+1000*.1*2**3 = 1700 active cells; changed 1000*(1-.2)+1000*.2*2**3 = 2400 active cells. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.

The recurrence a[i] = a[i−1]+1 depends on the previous iteration, unlike independent assignments a[i] = b[i]+1. Synthetic initial a [0] = 2 through i = 8; compare initial value 5 with the same eight updates. Nominal 2+8 = 10 a[8]; changed 5+8 = 13 a[8]. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
